objects.name: base
objects.prompt: A solid, perfectly square 32×32 pixel sandy floor tile for a whimsical fantasy goblin colony simulator. The entire square is completely filled with fine, compacted sand in muted golden beige, warm ochre, pale sandstone and dusty tan tones. Subtle scattered grains, tiny pebbles and gentle natural colour variations create a soft sandy texture. Flat, continuous horizontal ground surface with no irregular outer edges, no rounded corners, no empty spaces and no transparency. Cute fantasy pixel art, fixed three-quarter JRPG perspective, crisp pixel placement, limited harmonious colour palette and subtle shading. Seamlessly repeating texture on all four edges, with no visible tile boundaries, black borders or outlines. Perfectly square, fully opaque, edge-to-edge sand texture. No objects, vegetation, characters or text.
